The '''1971–72 Cypriot First Division''' was the 33rd season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.

==Overview==
It was contested by 12 teams, and [[AC Omonia]] won the championship.  [[Olympiakos Nicosia]] participated in the [[1971–72 Alpha Ethniki|Greek championship]] as the previous year's champions. They finished in 18th position.
